# Pinned versions for the CI security scanners (.github/workflows/security.yml).
#
# These were `pip install <tool> --quiet` with no version, so each run silently
# pulled whatever PyPI had latest — no reproducibility, no changelog, and a bad
# release could break CI with nothing to point at. Pinned here so Dependabot
# (see .github/dependabot.yml, pip ecosystem) opens a PR per bump instead.
semgrep==1.178.0
zizmor==1.30.1
